stories.title: Google Cloud Outage Knocks UK Banks, Websites and Court Systems Offline
stories.description: A Google Cloud outage disrupted UK banks, business websites and court video links on Tuesday, October 20, after a power event hit its London infrastructure.

stories.title: 3 Ways Threat Intelligence Makes Life Easier for American SOC Analysts
stories.description: October is Cybersecurity Awareness Month, a good time to rethink how SOC analysts detect and investigate threats, draw conclusions from the first three quarters of 2026, and see how exactly your daily workflows could be improved.

stories.title: US Agencies Detail Incident Response Practices for Rogue AI Agents
stories.description: NIST, CISA and NSA share ten voluntary practices for preparing for, detecting, responding to, recovering from, and reporting rogue AI agent incidents.

stories.title: Critical FortiSIEM Flaw Gets Public Exploit PoC for Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
stories.description: Researchers release a PoC for critical FortiSIEM flaw CVE-2026-106173, showing how unauthenticated attackers can achieve remote code execution.

stories.title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
stories.description: Qilin and INC ransomware actors continue exploiting a patched Palo Alto Networks flaw to gain network access, bypass MFA, and establish VPN sessions.

stories.title: FBI Suspects Cybersecurity Executive Helped ShinyHunters Run Extortion Website
stories.description: Federal investigators suspect an executive at a United States consulting firm helped ShinyHunters operate a website used to pressure hacked companies into paying ransom demands.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Open Banking Services to Test Stolen Credentials Without Paying a Cent
stories.description: Criminals abuse open banking to verify stolen credentials and send phishing messages impersonating Poshmark.

stories.title: Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites
stories.description: Exposed Cairn panels reveal autonomous AI attacks on over 1,200 websites, with confirmed breaches and leaked credentials.

stories.title: AOMEI Backupper Compromised in Short-Burst Supply Chain Campaign
stories.description: Across multiple short compromise windows, users were served a downloader for the ShinyRoad modular backdoor framework.

stories.title: The Key to AI Software Security Isn’t Speed, It’s Maturity
stories.description: Where your developers sit on the AI adoption scale has a real impact on how you are addressing security risk.

stories.title: Ahold Delhaize Restoring Services Disrupted by Cyberattack
stories.description: The company has restored many websites and apps in Europe and expects e-commerce brands in the US to be restored in days.

stories.title: Pegasus Spyware Infection Confirmed on Serbian University Rector's iPhone Days Before Election
stories.description: Citizen Lab confirmed Pegasus on a Serbian university rector's iPhone and flagged likely spyware targeting of a prosecutor ahead of elections.

stories.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
stories.description: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion…

stories.description: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are…

stories.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
stories.description: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly…

stories.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
